paper.title_en: Strong Co-O exchange interaction in $P4/nmm$ KCoO$_2$ and its effect on spin wave and Néel temperature
paper.abstract_en: The exchange interactions of a classical Heisenberg Hamiltonian in KCoO$_2$ in the $P4/nnm$ structure are calculated using a linear response approach, derived from the transverse spin susceptibility, integrated over atomic spheres using a projector proportional the local magnetization and including all atoms as magnetic atoms. The exchange interaction between Co and its apical O is found to be by far the largest interaction and ferromagnetic. Its effect on the Néel temperature and the spin wave spectrum are evaluated. The Co-O exchange is found to strongly enhance the critical temperature in the mean field approximation but not in the random phase approximation.
